# SelectorSwitch

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Rotary selector with 2 to 5 labelled positions, optionally a key switch (IND-010 .. IND-013).

![SelectorSwitch, light theme](../img/widgets/selector-switch-light.png#only-light){ width="148" }
![SelectorSwitch, dark theme](../img/widgets/selector-switch-dark.png#only-dark){ width="148" }

**Controls, discrete** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.SelectorSwitch) ·
schema [`selectorswitch.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.SelectorSwitch(value="AUTO", label="SelectorSwitch")
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[140,130]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | string | `""` | host, widget | Label of the selected position. Empty, or not one of positions: default_position, else the middle position (the Python class resolves it when the widget is created). |
| `positions` | array of string | `["HAND","OFF","AUTO"]` | host | 2 to 5 distinct position labels, left to right. |
| `keyed` | boolean | `false` | host | Key switch: with locked, the front end cannot move it (IND-012). |
| `locked` | boolean | `false` | host | Key removed: the position is locked for the operator (the host can still set it). |
| `default_position` | string or null | `null` | host | Position the switch returns to from a spring-return position; also the resolved value. Ignored when not one of positions. |
| `spring_return` | array of string | `[]` | host | Positions that go back to default_position when the operator releases the switch (IND-013). |
